task_name: Contextual family-facing PWA install and Chapters route affordance
user_visible_outcome: Family visitors see no normal-state Online strip; an install action appears only when the browser offers installation or an Apple home-screen route, while offline and update notices remain truthful. The Chapters empty state makes First Days visibly actionable.
non_negotiable_quality: Do not weaken service-worker registration, offline truthfulness, update activation, family access, logout, private media, or publishing boundaries.
Keep keyboard focus and screen-reader announcements for actionable and temporary PWA messages.
Do not show a normal-state Online label or an empty PWA container.
realistic_harms_prevented: A permanent status strip distracts from the private family archive and implies that Online needs attention.
A plain-text route instruction can be missed by visitors when Chapters is empty.
Removing the PWA surface wholesale could hide meaningful offline or update notices.
simplest_acceptable_approach: Conditionally render the existing PWA surface only for a real install option, offline notice, or ready update; add local CSS for the existing First Days link.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A normal online non-installable browser renders no PWA strip and no Online label.
acceptance_criteria.proof_type: source review and live browser check

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A browser install opportunity still exposes an Install Pawpaw action; Apple visitors can reveal Add to Home Screen guidance.
acceptance_criteria.proof_type: source review and live browser check

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Offline and ready-update notices remain available, with the existing service-worker registration and update activation intact.
Read First Days is visibly an accessible link in the Chapters empty state.
acceptance_criteria.proof_type: source review and live browser check

non_goals: Changing PWA manifest, icons, caching strategy, service-worker logic, offline application behaviour, or install eligibility.
Changing family/Admin authentication, data, publishing, private media, First Days content, Stage 3 art, or page layout.
Adding dependencies, migrations, services, analytics, tests that write data, or a new admin control.
verification: Focused unit test for conditional PWA rendering and retained offline/update/install paths.
Type check and lint in the repository execution environment.
Owner live review: normal browser, installable Chrome, Chapters empty-state link.
